summary: Added extractTokens() function to bench-heldout.js that reads the session transcript JSONL and sums input_tokens, output_tokens, and cache_read_input_tokens across all assistant messages. Added inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, totalTokens fields to the per-trial JSON output. Smoke-tested with locale-sum/off/99 — output confirmed non-zero token values (outputTokens: 14899, cacheReadTokens: 301472).

subject: Add token extraction to bench results
description: After each trial, extract total tokens (input + output) from the session transcript JSONL. Sum usage fields across all assistant messages. Add `tokens` field to the result row in results-heldout.jsonl. Backfill existing trials where transcriptPath exists.
